title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Sensor Placement in Water Distribution Networks: A Systematic Literature Review — Reproducibility Package
description: Working reproducibility package for a systematic literature review. The review searched seven information sources and reports 417 imported records, 40 duplicates removed, 377 title/abstract records screened, 41 full texts assessed, and four included studies. Package includes methods, search strategies, Covidence import history, PRISMA counts, included-study register, manuscript-derived synthesis, appraisal materials and manuscript/figures. Original Covidence screening and extraction exports remain outstanding. Publisher full-text PDFs and full extracted article texts are excluded because redistribution rights have not been established.
